line.s1_intro.text: Owl, a picnic by the lake! I brought the cups and you brought the plates.

line.s1_pair.text: Every cup stands by its plate. Look what is left.

line.s1_result.text: One cup has no pair. There are more cups than plates.

line.s1_owl_fewer.text: And there are fewer plates than cups. One is missing!

line.s2_signs.text: I know a sign that says which pile has more. It looks like a hungry mouth.

line.s2_more_sign.text: The mouth opens towards the pile with more. There are more cups, so it opens towards the cups.

line.s2_summary.text: More, fewer or as many. The mouth always opens where there is more.

line.p_intro.text: Your turn. I'll show two piles and you point to the one with more.

line.p_wrong_pair.text: Let's check in pairs. Look what is left without a pair.

line.p_signs_intro.text: Now the signs. Pick the mouth that fits, or the equal lines when there are as many.

line.p_wrong_sign.text: Not that one. The mouth opens where there is more. When there are as many, pick the equal lines.

line.a_owl_table.text: A home game: setting the table. I put out the plates, Fox the cups.

line.a_fox_check.text: Let's check in pairs: cup and plate, cup and plate.

line.a_ask_parents.text: Ask your parents to play this with you at home. When you set the table, check in pairs whether everyone has a plate and which there is more of!

line.s1_point_left.text: One is left without a pair. Show me which one.

line.s1_wrong_left.text: That one has a pair. Look for the one standing alone.

line.s2_pick_gt.text: Point to the sign whose mouth opens towards the cups.

line.s2_pick_eq.text: There are as many. Point to the equal lines.

line.s2_pick_lt.text: There are fewer cups. Point to the mouth open towards the plates.

line.s2_which_more.text: And now point to the pile with more.

line.good_gt.text: Very good! The mouth opens to the left, because there is more on the left.

line.good_lt.text: Very good! The mouth opens to the right, because there is more on the right.

line.good_eq.text: Very good! Equal lines, because there are as many.

line.good_more.text: Very good! There is more here.

line.s2_good_gt.text: Yes! The mouth is open towards the cups, because there are more cups than plates.

line.j2_to_garden.text: Let's go to the garden now. Fox promised carrots for lunch!

line.j2_garden.text: This is my garden. I pulled out some carrots!

line.j2_carrots.text: Here they are, on the path.

line.j2_flowers.text: And I picked flowers for the vase. Are there as many flowers as carrots?

line.j2_check.text: Let's check in pairs: carrot and flower, carrot and flower.

line.j2_equal.text: Nothing is left. Every carrot has its flower. There are as many!

line.j2_eq_sign.text: When there are as many, the mouth closes and two equal lines are left. This sign says: as many.

line.j2_pick_lt.text: There are fewer carrots. Point to the mouth that opens towards the flowers.

line.j2_pick_sign.text: Which sign fits here? Point to it.

line.j2_good_eq.text: Yes! Equal lines, because there are as many carrots as flowers.

line.j2_one_more.text: Oh, one more flower is growing by the fence! I'll pick it.

line.j2_now_fewer.text: Now there are more flowers and fewer carrots. Which sign shows that?

line.j2_good_lt.text: Yes! The mouth opens towards the flowers, because there are more flowers.

line.j2_to_home.text: We have the carrots. Let's go home, I'll bake cookies!

line.j2_kitchen.text: The cookies smell good! I put out cups of milk. Will every cup get a cookie?

line.j2_cookies_check.text: Let's check in pairs: cup and cookie, cup and cookie.

line.j2_one_missing.text: One cup has no cookie. There are fewer cookies.

line.j2_bake_one.text: Don't worry, I'll bake one more!

line.j2_good_eq2.text: Yes! Now every cup has a cookie. As many!

line.m0_question.text: Will every cup get its own plate?

line.m0_naive.text: Sure! There are more plates, because they are so big.

line.m0_not.text: Big does not mean there are more of them!

line.m0_how.text: Then how do we find out what there is more of?

line.m0_pairs.text: By making pairs! Every cup gets one plate.

line.m0_what.text: Pairs? How do you do that?

line.m0_show.text: I will show you. It is like dancing in pairs: one cup and one plate.

line.m0_fetch.text: One plate is missing. I'll bring one!

line.m0_enough.text: Now every cup has its plate. There are as many!

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for our adventure together! Here's a sticker for your album, to remember it by. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is the flower from Owl. We got it when we learned where there is more and where there is less.
